Assemble WHEP's cell-polity crosswalk with true grid-cell area.

Source: R/n_balance_spatialize.R
build_cell_polity.Rd

Reads the cached cell-polity fraction parquet (lon, lat, area_code, polity_frac) and adds cell_area_ha, computed from latitude with the same 0.5-degree cell-area formula used across the package (see build_grass_availability_lpjml()). This assembles the data$cell_polity contract that every Module C function (e.g. build_n_deposition(), build_urban_n(), get_soc_climate_drivers()) expects as a required input.

Usage

build_cell_polity(polity_fraction_path = NULL)

Arguments

polity_fraction_path

Path to the cell-polity fraction parquet. Defaults to Sys.getenv("WHEP_POLITY_FRACTION_PATH").

Value

A tibble with lon, lat, area_code, polity_frac and cell_area_ha.

Examples

# Requires WHEP_POLITY_FRACTION_PATH to be set; not run without it.
if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("WHEP_POLITY_FRACTION_PATH"))) {
  build_cell_polity()
}
